page_title: HOF 1-1 HEI | Hoffenheim v Heidenheim 27/01/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' That's it for today, Tobias Welz has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+6' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Hoffenheim comes to nothing.

90+6' Marius Bulter (Hoffenheim) attempts to convert a lofted cross as he jumps high and heads the ball to the top left corner. Kevin Muller shows his brilliant reflexes and pulls off a glorious save to stop the ball from hitting the net.
90+4' Florian Grillitsch (Hoffenheim) has tested the patience of referee Tobias Welz and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
90+3' We are about to witness a subsitution. Norman Theuerkauf (Heidenheim) for Jan Schoppner.
90' 4 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
89' John Anthony Brooks (Hoffenheim) shouldn't be surprised it's a yellow from the ref, who cooled the situation down well.
87' Frank Schmidt has decided to substitute Jan-Niklas Beste and he is replaced by Marnon Busch (Heidenheim).
86' Here comes a substitution. Wout Weghorst is given a rest as he is replaced by Marius Bulter (Hoffenheim).
86' We are about to witness a substitution. Tom Bischof (Hoffenheim) is replacing Andrej Kramaric.
86' That looked a certain handball by Wout Weghorst (Hoffenheim) inside the box, but the ref wasn't having it and just played on. NO penalty!
85' Kevin Muller pulls off a great save to deny Andrej Kramaric (Hoffenheim), who makes himself some space inside the box and unleashes a quick low drive to the bottom left corner.
84' Kevin Sessa (Heidenheim) decided to shoot after receiving a sweet pass. If it wasn't for Oliver Baumann's superb save the ball would have probably ended up in the bottom right corner.
83' Robert Skov (Hoffenheim) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
81' Good defending. Grischa Promel (Hoffenheim) tries to find Wout Weghorst inside the box, but the pass is cut out.
78' Tim Kleindienst (Heidenheim) nearly creates a chance, but his attempt to pick out a teammate with a through ball does not come off.
75' Wout Weghorst links up with Ihlas Bebou (Hoffenheim), who fires just wide of the left post from the edge of the box. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Heidenheim.

74' Lennard Maloney (Heidenheim) fails to connect properly with the corner kick and plants his header way over the bar from the centre of the box. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Hoffenheim.
74' Jan-Niklas Beste (Heidenheim) is heading toward the corner flag to take the set piece.
74' Here comes a substitution. Ihlas Bebou (Hoffenheim) is brought on as a substitute for Maximilian Beier.
72' Tobias Welz shows a yellow card to Kevin Akpoguma (Hoffenheim) for his blatant foul.
71' Substitution. Kevin Sessa (Heidenheim) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Eren Dinkci walks off.
71' Here is a change. Adrian Beck is going off and Frank Schmidt gives the last tactical orders to Marvin Pieringer (Heidenheim).
70' Robert Skov (Hoffenheim) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger.
67' Andrej Kramaric (Hoffenheim) was close to scoring after he unleashed a powerful shot which went a whisker wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Heidenheim.
66' Umut Tohumcu (Hoffenheim) wins the ball after the corner kick and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's blocked by one of the defending players.
66' Andrej Kramaric (Hoffenheim) steps up to send the ball in.
63' Pellegrino Matarazzo prepares a substitution. Anton Stach is replaced by Umut Tohumcu (Hoffenheim).
63' Substitution. Pavel Kaderabek leaves the pitch and is replaced by Robert Skov (Hoffenheim).

63' Anton Stach (Hoffenheim) fashions a shot from the edge of the box after receiving an accurate pass. Kevin Muller makes a comfortable save to stop the effort from flying into the middle of the goal.
59' Anton Stach (Hoffenheim) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Tobias Welz had an easy-decision to make.
58' Jan-Niklas Beste (Heidenheim) puts a cross into the box from the corner but there is no panic from the opposition and they easily clear.
55' Jan-Niklas Beste (Heidenheim) crosses the ball from the free kick, but it goes out of play. The ball goes out of play and Hoffenheim will have a goal kick.
53' Hoffenheim take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.

53' Wout Weghorst (Hoffenheim) collects a pass from the flank, looks up and fires in a goal-bound shot from the edge of the box which canons off a defender to safety. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Hoffenheim.
50' Andrej Kramaric (Hoffenheim) swings in the corner, but it's comfortably cleared away.

50' Kevin Muller pulls off a great save to deny Maximilian Beier (Hoffenheim), who makes himself some space inside the box and unleashes a quick low drive to the bottom right corner. Hoffenheim force their opponents to concede a corner.
49' The resulting corner, taken by Andrej Kramaric (Hoffenheim), comes to nothing.

49' Andrej Kramaric (Hoffenheim) launches the ball from the resulting corner, but one of the defenders is first to the ball and deals with the threat. The ball is out of play and Hoffenheim manage to earn a corner.

48' A dangerous attempt from Florian Grillitsch (Hoffenheim) was aimed to the top left corner, but Kevin Muller pulls off a superb save and stops this one. The linesman points to the corner flag, Hoffenheim are going to take it.

47' Andrej Kramaric sprays a wonderful pass out to Grischa Promel (Hoffenheim), who cannot get enough power or direction to cause Kevin Muller problems and the goalkeeper is able to watch the ball go just over the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Heidenheim.
46' Frank Schmidt makes a switch. Tim Siersleben (Heidenheim) is coming on in place of Benedikt Gimber at the start of the second period.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+7' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+7' 1 - 1 Goal! Andrej Kramaric (Hoffenheim) runs up to the ball, stops and waits for Kevin Muller to commit before slotting the penalty into the bottom right corner.
45+6' Andrej Kramaric (Hoffenheim) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
45+6' It’s a PENALTY to Hoffenheim after the VAR review!
45+5' Referee Tobias Welz makes the VAR signal and is going to check whether it’s a penalty for Hoffenheim. Let’s see what happens!
45+4' Benedikt Gimber (Heidenheim) appears to handle the ball in the box, but the ref turns down the penalty appeals and waves play on!
45+4' The resulting set piece, sent into the penalty area by Andrej Kramaric (Hoffenheim), was easily dealt with by one of the defenders.

45+2' Andrej Kramaric bends the corner in towards the goal and finds Maximilian Beier (Hoffenheim) almost on the goal line, but he somehow contrives to head the ball high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Heidenheim will have a goal kick.
45+2' Andrej Kramaric (Hoffenheim) is about to take a corner kick.
45+2' Stanley Nsoki (Hoffenheim) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. Hoffenheim have a corner.
45' There will be a minimum of 3 min. of added time.
43' Poor challenge! Adrian Beck (Heidenheim) is penalised for tripping and Tobias Welz blows his whistle.
40' Benedikt Gimber (Heidenheim) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
39' Some patient build-up play from Hoffenheim as they look to unlock the defence.
37' Benedikt Gimber (Heidenheim) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
37' Adrian Beck (Heidenheim) wins the ball after the corner kick and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's blocked by one of the defending players.
37' There's an opportunity for Jan-Niklas Beste (Heidenheim) to deliver the ball into the box from a corner.
36' Maximilian Beier (Hoffenheim) commits a foul and Tobias Welz immediately signals a free kick.
33' Eren Dinkci (Heidenheim) gets on the end of a pass on the edge of the box but his shot is blocked.
29' 0 - 1 Eren Dinkci (Heidenheim) finds himself one-on-one with the keeper after a great pass by Jan Schoppner. He takes the shot early and scores!
29' Omar Haktab Traore (Heidenheim) fires a powerful shot which is blocked.
27' The corner kick from Andrej Kramaric (Hoffenheim) is headed out of the penalty area by one of the defenders.
26' Florian Grillitsch (Hoffenheim) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
25' Looks like Florian Grillitsch (Hoffenheim) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.

24' Wout Weghorst latches onto a perfect defence-splitting pass from Stanley Nsoki (Hoffenheim) and heads towards goal. Wout Weghorst (Hoffenheim) sends in a pass which fails to reach any of his teammates.
23' Andrej Kramaric (Hoffenheim) attempts to feed Maximilian Beier with a chip pass, but Kevin Muller reacts well and comes off his line to intercept.

19' Tim Kleindienst (Heidenheim) comes close to scoring. He meets a lovely lofted pass from Jan-Niklas Beste, but sends his close-range header way over the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and Hoffenheim will have a goal kick.
19' Heidenheim take a short corner kick.
18' The resulting corner from Jan-Niklas Beste (Heidenheim) only finds one of the defenders, who heads it out of danger. Now Heidenheim have a corner.

18' The defence had a hard time blocking out the strike from Eren Dinkci (Heidenheim). He didn't hesitate and finished from outside the box right after he had received a pass from his teammate. The ball is out of play. Heidenheim will have a chance to score from a corner.
15' What a save from Kevin Muller! Wout Weghorst (Hoffenheim) jumps high to meet a cross and glances a promising header from close range, but the goalkeeper pulls off a brilliant stop to keep it out.
15' Wout Weghorst (Hoffenheim) connects with an accurate pass inside the box and fires the ball to the bottom right corner, but one of the defending players steps in to block the effort.
14' Hoffenheim keep possession of the ball with some short passes, waiting for the moment to hit the opposition swiftly on the break.
12' Anton Stach (Hoffenheim) serves up a nice cross, but Kevin Muller punches the ball away.
10' Maximilian Beier (Hoffenheim) gets on the end of a good pass and from mid-range he unleashes a decent strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
8' Anton Stach (Hoffenheim) wins the ball after the corner kick and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's blocked by one of the defending players.
8' Corner kick. Andrej Kramaric (Hoffenheim) is ready to send the ball into the box.
7' Maximilian Beier (Hoffenheim) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. Hoffenheim force a corner. They send men into the box.
5' Patrick Mainka (Heidenheim) whips a long ball in from the free kick which is intercepted by Oliver Baumann.

3' Maximilian Beier (Hoffenheim) collects a sweet pass on the edge of the box and in one movement smashes a shot in on goal, but it balloons high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Heidenheim.
1' The match has just started.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Heidenheim will have the kick-off.
Tobias Welz will supervise the game today.
